rationale: DDOG is down ~9.4% on a gap caused by disappointing Q4 guidance, trading near the session low (4.3% position in range) with price just above $186.94 support — a breakdown setup exists but the stock is already deeply extended from VWAP ($193.50) and the 9-EMA ($188.18) is essentially at price, offering no clean directional edge. The broad market is strongly up (SPY +1.73%, VIXY -9.55%), which creates a cross-current against a short thesis, while the fundamental overhang (flat guidance, margin compression) argues against a sustained long bounce; with 117 minutes to close and no clear momentum confirmation in either direction, the risk/reward is insufficient to justify a new position.
